records.name: Milwaukee department boundaries
records.content:
define MilwaukeeSupport as device with greatlakes.location:'Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA' and greatlakes.department:'Customer Support'.
define MilwaukeeFinance as device with greatlakes.location:'Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA' and greatlakes.department:Finance.
define MilwaukeeShipping as device with greatlakes.location:'Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA' and greatlakes.department:Shipping.
define MilwaukeeReceiving as device with greatlakes.location:'Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA' and greatlakes.department:Receiving.
records.summary: Customer Support, Finance, Shipping, and Receiving apps are available only to their corresponding Milwaukee departments.

records.name: Shenzhen engineering access
records.content:
define ShenzhenEngineering as device with greatlakes.location:'Shenzhen, China' and greatlakes.department:'Shenzhen Engineering'.
define EngineeringBuildFarm as service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:'engineering-build-farm'.
provide EngineeringBuildFarm at engineering-build.svc.zpr over TCP 8444.
  allow ShenzhenEngineering.
records.summary: Shenzhen Engineering can use the build farm, with no grants to HQ business systems.

records.name: Tijuana assembly and test access
records.content:
define TijuanaAssembly as device with greatlakes.location:'Tijuana, Mexico' and greatlakes.department:Assembly.
define TijuanaTest as device with greatlakes.location:'Tijuana, Mexico' and greatlakes.department:'Test and Quality'.
define AssemblyExecution as service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:'assembly-mes'.
define QualityTestBench as service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:'quality-test-bench'.
provide AssemblyExecution at assembly-mes.svc.zpr over TCP 8448.
  allow TijuanaAssembly.
provide QualityTestBench at quality-test.svc.zpr over TCP 8449.
  allow TijuanaTest.
records.summary: Tijuana Assembly and Test can reach only their assigned production and quality systems.

records.name: Workday service endpoints
records.content:
define FinanceClient as device with zpr.adapter.cn:'finance-client'.
define OperationsClient as device with zpr.adapter.cn:'operations-client'.
define TelemetryClient as device with zpr.adapter.cn:'telemetry-client'.
define WorkdayEcho as service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:'echo-service'.
define WorkdayMetrics as service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:'metrics-service'.
provide WorkdayEcho at echo-web.svc.zpr over TCP 8080.
  allow FinanceClient.
provide WorkdayMetrics at metrics-web.svc.zpr over TCP 8081.
  allow OperationsClient.
  allow TelemetryClient.
records.summary: Finance, operations, and telemetry clients receive explicit service scopes for the compressed workday simulation.
